message:
Partial refunds now come out at the right size, and `npm test` passes all 20 tests, including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.

The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. The function treated `percent` as a fraction, but it's a 0–100 value, so a 50% refund came out 50 times too large. It now divides by 100 before rounding, so 50% of 1250 gives 625. I changed only that file, so nothing outside `src/payments` was touched.
